name: noxdeck
description: A retro terminal dashboard beside the transcript: status with Nox (a pixel picture where the terminal draws pictures, in one of five costumes, in block characters elsewhere), the context window, a radar for loops, failures, hotspots and waits (or Claude's plan), changed files and subagents with their tokens, model and current activity, a press on one showing its transcript. Observes only.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The noxdeck pane's color theme; every theme draws in your Claude Code theme's colors.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane's sentences and states: en (English, the default) or de (German). Tab names, card titles and established terms stay English.

limitStyle.title: 5h limit
limitStyle.description: How the STATUS card draws the 5h limit: five hearts (hearts) or a ten-cell bar (bar).

noxStyle.title: Nox style
noxStyle.description: How Nox is drawn: fein, a pixel picture where the terminal draws pictures (the default; Ghostty, kitty; the block characters elsewhere), or klassisch, the block characters always.

noxPalette.title: Nox palette
noxPalette.description: The fine Nox's colors: standard (lavender), nacht (blue and silver) or retro (shades of green).

noxCostume.title: Nox costume
noxCostume.description: The fine Nox's costume: ohne (Nox as it is, the default), zauberer, astronaut, detektiv or hacker; zufall draws one of the four at each session's start and keeps it until the session ends, a reload included. The block Nox wears none.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: How much Nox moves: voll (every animation), ruhig (blinking and the change of state only) or aus (a still picture). Claude Code's Reduce motion setting holds voll to ruhig.
